data.one_liner: Real-time hand landmark detection on Android using Google MediaPipe and JNI.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that performs real-time hand landmark detection using Google's MediaPipe Hand Landmarker task on Android. It processes a camera image stream via a JNI bridge and delivers hand coordinates asynchronously without blocking the UI thread.
use_when: You need real-time hand tracking and landmark detection in a Flutter Android app
You want non-blocking inference running on a background thread to prevent UI jank
You want to bypass expensive JPEG compression using direct YUV to ARGB conversion
avoid_when: You need iOS support (only Android is supported)
You require synchronous detection calls (only asynchronous streaming via landmarkStream is supported)
strengths: Non-blocking live tracking on a background thread
Bundled MediaPipe hand_landmarker.task model requires no manual setup
Optimized JNI bridge with custom YUV to ARGB conversion
weaknesses: Requires minimum Flutter SDK 3.44 and JDK 17
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter SDK 3.44 or higher and JDK 17 or higher. The required MediaPipe model is bundled with the plugin.
